user.title: Add tracking numbers
user.description: Add one or more DHL tracking numbers to track (press Enter after each). You can also start empty and add tracking numbers later via the integration's options.

init.description: Add or remove tracking numbers and adjust the update interval.

add_tracking_number.name: Add tracking number
add_tracking_number.description: Adds a DHL tracking number to Paketverfolgung, unless it's already tracked.
